⚫ Othello

Also known as Reversi: start with four discs in the center, then place your disc so that it brackets one or more opponent discs between your new disc and an existing one of yours. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Place your disc so that it brackets one or more opponent discs.
  2. Bracketing means your disc and an existing disc of yours surround opponent discs on a line.
  3. All bracketed opponent discs flip to your color.
  4. You must make a legal move — pass if none is available.
  5. Corner and edge squares are strategically valuable.
